state.question: How do I stop the weekly summary emails? I still want alerts when a payment fails.

article.instructions: Which help article best answers the customer question in state.question?

criteria.hc_204: Change your email address: update the address we send all mail to
criteria.hc_311: Notification settings: turn each email type on or off, such as summaries, alerts and product news
criteria.hc_118: Failed payments: why a payment fails and how to retry it
criteria.hc_402: Unsubscribe from marketing: stop newsletters and offers with one link
criteria.hc_087: Close your account: delete your account and all data
criteria.no_good_match: None of these articles answers the question
